info.title: API.SH: Wegmans
info.description: The Wegmans API from API.SH: public Wegmans data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Search suggestions for a partial query as the shop's search box shows them, with an image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wegmans-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial query.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Suggestions (default 10, max 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: fulfilment

parameters.description: Only categories with products matching these keywords.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wegmans-product

parameters.name: store_id

get.description:
Search Wegmans products by keywords or browse a category, for one store, with the shop's filters (facet values from `facets`), a price range and four sorts. Each product: id, name, brand, size, link, images, in-store, pickup and delivery prices, loyalty prices, discount type, offers and coupon ids, rating, review count, availability, sold by weight, fulfilment types, EBT eligibility, new-item flag, tags, categories, aisle and UPC. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wegmans-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path from /wegmans/v1/categories, levels joined by " > ", e.g. Dairy > Milk, Juice and Refrigerated Beverage.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as name:value pairs, comma-separated, e.g. consumerBrandName:Wegmans.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest in-store price (USD).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest in-store price (USD).

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: Price list: in-store, pickup or delivery.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Wegmans store number the prices and aisles are for (default 1; see /wegmans/v1/stores).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 48, max 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Wegmans store by number: address, phone, coordinates, status, opening hours, pharmacy, alcohol sales, its wine and spirits shop and an image, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wegmans-store

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Wegmans store number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Wegmans store, or those in one state, matching a text, or sorted by distance from a point: store number, name, address, phone, coordinates, status, opening date, pickup and delivery flags.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wegmans-stores

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state, e.g. NC.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the name, city, ZIP or address.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude (with longitude: nearest first, with distance in miles).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
